paragraphs.text: translated by
1. MEN have abstained from pouring juice they count not Indra as a God.
paragraphs.original: वि हि सोतोरसृक्षत नेन्द्रं देवममंसत ।
paragraphs.translit: vi hi sotorasṛkṣata nendraṃ devamamaṃsata |

paragraphs.text: Where at the votary's store my friend Vrsakapi hath drunk his fill. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: यत्रामदद्वृषाकपिरर्यः पुष्टेषु मत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: yatrāmadadvṛṣākapiraryaḥ puṣṭeṣu matsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Thou, Indra, heedless passest by the ill Vrsakapi hath wrought;
paragraphs.original: परा हीन्द्र धावसि वृषाकपेरति व्यथिः ।
paragraphs.translit: parā hīndra dhāvasi vṛṣākaperati vyathiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Yet nowhere else thou findest place wherein to drink the Soma juice. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: नो अह प्र विन्दस्यन्यत्र सोमपीतये विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: no aha pra vindasyanyatra somapītaye viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. What hath he done to injure thee, this tawny beast Vrsakapi,
paragraphs.original: किमयं त्वां वृषाकपिश्चकार हरितो मृगः ।
paragraphs.translit: kimayaṃ tvāṃ vṛṣākapiścakāra harito mṛgaḥ |

paragraphs.text: With whom thou art so angry now? What is the votary's foodful store? Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: यस्मा इरस्यसीदु न्वर्यो वा पुष्टिमद्वसु विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: yasmā irasyasīdu nvaryo vā puṣṭimadvasu viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Soon may the hound who hunts the boar seize him and bite him in the car,
paragraphs.original: यमिमं त्वं वृषाकपिं प्रियमिन्द्राभिरक्षसि ।
paragraphs.translit: yamimaṃ tvaṃ vṛṣākapiṃ priyamindrābhirakṣasi |

paragraphs.text: O Indra, that Vrsakapi whom thou protectest as a friend, Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: श्वा न्वस्य जम्भिषदपि कर्णे वराहयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: śvā nvasya jambhiṣadapi karṇe varāhayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Kapi hath marred the beauteous things, all deftly wrought, that were my joy.
paragraphs.original: प्रिया तष्टानि मे कपिर्व्यक्ता व्यदूदुषत् ।
paragraphs.translit: priyā taṣṭāni me kapirvyaktā vyadūduṣat |

paragraphs.text: In pieces will I rend his head; the sinner's portion shall be woe. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: शिरो न्वस्य राविषं न सुगं दुष्कृते भुवं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: śiro nvasya rāviṣaṃ na sugaṃ duṣkṛte bhuvaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. No Dame hath ampler charms than 1, or greater wealth of love's delights.
paragraphs.original: न मत्स्त्री सुभसत्तरा न सुयाशुतरा भुवत् ।
paragraphs.translit: na matstrī subhasattarā na suyāśutarā bhuvat |

paragraphs.text: None with more ardour offers all her beauty to her lord's embrace. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: न मत्प्रतिच्यवीयसी न सक्थ्युद्यमीयसी विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: na matpraticyavīyasī na sakthyudyamīyasī viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Mother whose love is quickly won, I say what verily will be.
paragraphs.original: उवे अम्ब सुलाभिके यथेवाङ्ग भविष्यति ।
paragraphs.translit: uve amba sulābhike yathevāṅga bhaviṣyati |

paragraphs.text: My breast, O Mother, and my head and both my hips seem quivering. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: भसन्मे अम्ब सक्थि मे शिरो मे वीव हृष्यति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: bhasanme amba sakthi me śiro me vīva hṛṣyati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Dame with the lovely hands and arms, with broad hair-plaits add ample hips,
paragraphs.original: किं सुबाहो स्वङ्गुरे पृथुष्टो पृथुजाघने ।
paragraphs.translit: kiṃ subāho svaṅgure pṛthuṣṭo pṛthujāghane |

paragraphs.text: Why, O thou Hero's wife, art thou angry with our Vrsakapi? Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: किं शूरपत्नि नस्त्वमभ्यमीषि वृषाकपिं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: kiṃ śūrapatni nastvamabhyamīṣi vṛṣākapiṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. This noxious creature looks on me as one bereft of hero's love,
paragraphs.original: अवीरामिव मामयं शरारुरभि मन्यते ।
paragraphs.translit: avīrāmiva māmayaṃ śarārurabhi manyate |

paragraphs.text: Yet Heroes for my sons have I, the Maruts' Friend and Indra's Queen. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: उताहमस्मि वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी मरुत्सखा विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: utāhamasmi vīriṇīndrapatnī marutsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. From olden time the matron goes to feast and general sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: संहोत्रं स्म पुरा नारी समनं वाव गच्छति ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃhotraṃ sma purā nārī samanaṃ vāva gacchati |

paragraphs.text: Mother of Heroes, Indra's Queen, the rite's ordainer is extolled. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: वेधा ऋतस्य वीरिणीन्द्रपत्नी महीयते विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: vedhā ṛtasya vīriṇīndrapatnī mahīyate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. So have I heard Indrani called most fortunate among these Dames,
paragraphs.original: इन्द्राणीमासु नारिषु सुभगामहमश्रवम् ।
paragraphs.translit: indrāṇīmāsu nāriṣu subhagāmahamaśravam |

paragraphs.text: For never shall her Consort die in future time through length of days. Supreme is Indra overall.
paragraphs.original: नह्यस्या अपरं चन जरसा मरते पतिर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: nahyasyā aparaṃ cana jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. Never, Indralni, have I joyed without my friend Vrsakapi,
paragraphs.original: नाहमिन्द्राणि रारण सख्युर्वृषाकपेरृते ।
paragraphs.translit: nāhamindrāṇi rāraṇa sakhyurvṛṣākaperṛte |

paragraphs.text: Whose welcome offering here, made pure with water, goeth to the Gods. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: यस्येदमप्यं हविः प्रियं देवेषु गच्छति विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: yasyedamapyaṃ haviḥ priyaṃ deveṣu gacchati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 13. Wealthy Vrsakapayi, blest with sons and consorts of thy sons,
paragraphs.original: वृषाकपायि रेवति सुपुत्र आदु सुस्नुषे । घसत्त इन्द्र उक्षणः प्रियं काचित्करं हविर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: vṛṣākapāyi revati suputra ādu susnuṣe | ghasatta indra ukṣaṇaḥ priyaṃ kācitkaraṃ havirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 14. The planets and satellites whose motion is seen to be destroyed in the sky are thirty-five.
paragraphs.original: उक्ष्णो हि मे पञ्चदश साकं पचन्ति विंशतिम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ukṣṇo hi me pañcadaśa sākaṃ pacanti viṃśatim |

paragraphs.text: In the beginning, all the planets and satellites were dependent on the last part of Revati Tara, they started moving according to the divine law, separated from Revati Tara.
paragraphs.original: उताहमद्मि पीव इदुभा कुक्षी पृणन्ति मे विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: utāhamadmi pīva idubhā kukṣī pṛṇanti me viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 15. Like as a bull with pointed horn, loud bellowing amid the herds,
paragraphs.original: वृषभो न तिग्मशृङ्गोऽन्तर्यूथेषु रोरुवत् ।
paragraphs.translit: vṛṣabho na tigmaśṛṅgo'ntaryūtheṣu roruvat |

paragraphs.text: Sweet to thine heart, O Indra, is the brew which she who tends thee pours. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: मन्थस्त इन्द्र शं हृदे यं ते सुनोति भावयुर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: manthasta indra śaṃ hṛde yaṃ te sunoti bhāvayurviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 18. O Indra this Vrsakapi hath found a slain wild animal,
paragraphs.original: अयमिन्द्र वृषाकपिः परस्वन्तं हतं विदत् ।
paragraphs.translit: ayamindra vṛṣākapiḥ parasvantaṃ hataṃ vidat |

paragraphs.text: Dresser, and new-made pan, and knife, and wagon with a load of wood. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: असिं सूनां नवं चरुमादेधस्यान आचितं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: asiṃ sūnāṃ navaṃ carumādedhasyāna ācitaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 19. Distinguishing the Dasa and the Arya, viewing all, I go.
paragraphs.original: अयमेमि विचाकशद्विचिन्वन्दासमार्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ayamemi vicākaśadvicinvandāsamāryam |

paragraphs.text: I look upon the wise, and drink the simple votary's Soma juice. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: पिबामि पाकसुत्वनोऽभि धीरमचाकशं विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: pibāmi pākasutvano'bhi dhīramacākaśaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 20. The desert plains and steep descents, how many leagues in length they spread!
paragraphs.original: धन्व च यत्कृन्तत्रं च कति स्वित्ता वि योजना ।
paragraphs.translit: dhanva ca yatkṛntatraṃ ca kati svittā vi yojanā |

paragraphs.text: Go to the nearest houses, go unto thine home, Vrsakapi. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: नेदीयसो वृषाकपेऽस्तमेहि गृहाँ उप विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: nedīyaso vṛṣākape'stamehi gṛhām̐ upa viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 21. Turn thee again Vrsakapi: we twain will bring thee happiness.
paragraphs.original: पुनरेहि वृषाकपे सुविता कल्पयावहै ।
paragraphs.translit: punarehi vṛṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai |

paragraphs.text: Thou goest homeward on thy way along this path which leads to sleep. Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: य एष स्वप्ननंशनोऽस्तमेषि पथा पुनर्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: ya eṣa svapnanaṃśano'stameṣi pathā punarviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 22. When, Indra and Vrsakapi, ye travelled upward to your home,
paragraphs.original: यदुदञ्चो वृषाकपे गृहमिन्द्राजगन्तन ।
paragraphs.translit: yadudañco vṛṣākape gṛhamindrājagantana |

paragraphs.text: Where was that noisome beast, to whom went it, the beast that troubles man? Supreme is Indra over all.
paragraphs.original: क्व स्य पुल्वघो मृगः कमगञ्जनयोपनो विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: kva sya pulvagho mṛgaḥ kamagañjanayopano viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ

paragraphs.text: 23. Daughter of Manu, Parsu bare a score of children at a birth.
paragraphs.original: पर्शुर्ह नाम मानवी साकं ससूव विंशतिम् ।
paragraphs.translit: parśurha nāma mānavī sākaṃ sasūva viṃśatim |

paragraphs.text: Her portion verily was bliss although her burthen caused her grief.
paragraphs.original: भद्रं भल त्यस्या अभूद्यस्या उदरमामयद्विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः
paragraphs.translit: bhadraṃ bhala tyasyā abhūdyasyā udaramāmayadviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ
